I've completed a focused exploration of the pendo renderer CSS structure. Here are concise findings:

## 1. **Survey Type Identification in CSS**

Survey types are identified by class/id patterns:

- **All surveys**: `._pendo-guide-walkthrough_` class (no `data-layout` attribute)
- **NPS & number-scale (CSAT, UX-Lite, feedback)**: 
  - `._pendo-number-scale-poll-wrapper` wrapper
  - `._pendo-nps-poll-wrapper` (0–10 scale specifically)
  - `label.pendo-radio[class*="_pendo-number-scale-poll-"]`
  - `label.pendo-radio[class*="_pendo-nps-poll-"]`
- **PMF & single-choice**: `[id*="survey-pmf-answers"]`, `[id*="survey-single-choice"]`
- **Generic survey wrapper**: `.pendo-survey-wrapper` (wraps all survey content blocks)

## 2. **Current Centering Tweaks**

Located in source CSS files (source → generated):

- [button.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/button.css#L122-L127): Survey submit/finish buttons centered via `:has()` rule
  ```
  &._pendo-guide-walkthrough_:not([data-layout="tooltipBlank"], [data-layout="lightboxBlank"]) {
    div:has(> ._pendo-button-primaryButton):not(:has(> :not(._pendo-button-primaryButton))) {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }
  }
  ```

- [text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css#L155-L175): Survey text alignment rules (NPS question titles, label alignment)
  ```
  h2._pendo-text-title._pendo-nps-poll-success-message ._pendo-simple-text {
    text-align: center;
  }
  ```

- [card.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/card.css#L84-L103): Flexbox row layout, `[data-pendo-justify-content="center"]` for centered rows

## 3. **Files Requiring Modification & Generated Refresh**

**Source files to modify** (if adding new centering rules):
- [button.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/button.css) — survey button rules
- [text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css) — question header & label alignment  
- [container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css) — layout/padding for banner/lightbox surveys

**Generated files** (auto-refreshed):
- [generated/embedded.ts](renderers/pendo/generated/embedded.ts) — inlined CSS
- [generated/global.css](renderers/pendo/generated/global.css) — deployable stylesheet

**Build scripts to run**:
- [scripts/embed.ts](renderers/pendo/scripts/embed.ts) — inlines source CSS
- [scripts/generate.ts](renderers/pendo/scripts/generate.ts) — outputs `global.css`

## 4. **Validation Commands (using `vp`)**

```sh
# Refresh generated files after CSS edits
vp run embed && vp run generate

# Run full pendo test suite (validates CSS output)
vp run test

# Format/lint checks
vp check
```

Test file: [tests/build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts) has 28 tests including survey-specific checks (lines 186–210 cover banner/survey surface, scoping root targeting, and rating scale wrapping).

## 5. **@scope Selector Pitfalls**

**Critical pattern**: Survey rules use compound selector targeting scoping root:
```
:is(:scope, [class*="instui"])._pendo-guide-walkthrough_
```

**Pitfall**: Under `@scope [class*="instui"]._pendo-step-container`, bare `._pendo-guide-walkthrough_` **does not match** — only the `:scope` part does. Test `"survey rules target the scoping root, which a bare compound never matches under @scope"` (line 202) validates this.

**Key distinction**: 
- Surveys = `._pendo-guide-walkthrough_` guides with unequal banner/lightbox padding
- Feedback polls = number-scale inputs INSIDE guides (`[data-layout="lightboxBlank"]` with data attributes)
- Exclude guides with `data-layout="tooltipBlank"` or `data-layout="lightboxBlank"` from survey centering rules

## Summary: Files to Watch & Test

| File | Purpose | Anchor |
|------|---------|--------|
| [button.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/button.css#L122) | Survey button centering | Line 122–127 |
| [text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css#L118) | Survey header/label alignment | Line 118–175 |
| [inputs.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/inputs.css#L363) | Number-scale/NPS poll button styles | Line 363–430 |
| [build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts#L186) | Survey/banner/scoping tests | Lines 186–210 |

**Plan: Center Pendo Banner Surveys**

Add survey-only centering compensation for UX-lite, PMF, CSAT, and NPS survey forms rendered on the banner surface. The core fix should live where the asymmetry is created: [renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css). Keep the banner icon and close-button padding intact, then shift only `.pendo-survey-wrapper` content by half the difference between the left icon gutter and the right close-button reserve.

**Steps**

1. In [renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css), extend the banner block that defines `--_banner-close-button-reserve`, `--_banner-icon-size`, and banner padding. Add a private survey centering offset based on:
   `var(--_banner-close-button-reserve) - (var(--_banner-icon-size) + var(--instui-component-banner-relaxed-content-gap-horizontal))`, divided by `2`.

2. In the compact banner `@container pantoken-pendo-guide (max-width: 30em)` block, override that same offset using `var(--instui-component-banner-compact-content-gap-horizontal)`.

3. Add a scoped survey-banner rule in [container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css) targeting:
   `:is(:scope, [class*="instui"])._pendo-guide-walkthrough_:not([data-layout="tooltipBlank"], [data-layout="lightboxBlank"]):is([class*="instui-banner"]) .pendo-survey-wrapper`

   Apply the offset with `translate: var(--_banner-survey-center-offset) 0;`.

4. In [renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css), add survey-banner text alignment for question headers inside `.pendo-survey-wrapper`. Reuse the existing survey selectors around `.pendo-survey-wrapper`, `h2._pendo-text-title ._pendo-simple-text`, `._pendo-simple-text._pendo-nps-open-text-poll-question`, and `h3._pendo-simple-text`.

5. In [renderers/pendo/src/css/inputs.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/inputs.css), center answer groups under `.pendo-survey-wrapper` only. For UX/CSAT/NPS rating rows, build on the existing `.pendo-survey-wrapper > div:not([id*="survey-single-choice"]):has(input[type="radio"])` rule with `justify-content: center` and `margin-inline: auto` if needed. Avoid changing `._pendo-number-scale-poll-wrapper`, which is the feedback-poll risk area.

6. Update [renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts) near the existing survey/banner tests. Assert the new scoped selector, offset variable, compact override, and survey-wrapper centering rules are present. Add a negative assertion if practical so the feedback number-scale wrapper does not pick up this new centering path.

7. Regenerate generated assets from `renderers/pendo`:
   `vp run embed && vp run generate`

8. Run focused validation:
   `vp run test`

9. Run broader validation if time allows:
   `vp check`

10. Add a changeset for `@pantoken/pendo`, because this is a user-visible styling change.

**Relevant files**

- [renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/container.css) — banner padding and survey offset
- [renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/text.css) — survey question header alignment

- [renderers/pendo/generated/embedded.ts](renderers/pendo/generated/embedded.ts) — regenerated
- [renderers/pendo/generated/global.css](renderers/pendo/generated/global.css) — regenerated

**Decisions**

- Include UX-lite, PMF, CSAT, and NPS survey forms under `._pendo-guide-walkthrough_`.
- Exclude normal guide feedback polls by avoiding `._pendo-number-scale-poll-wrapper` and excluding `tooltipBlank` / `lightboxBlank`.
- Do not enumerate Pendo survey layout names; use root/theme classes.
- Use the existing `:is(:scope, [class*="instui"])._pendo-guide-walkthrough_` pattern because bare root selectors break under the scoped build.
